notes.title: Introducing Drug Dealer Simulator: Free Sample!
notes.notes:
Hey dealers!

The release of the full version of the Drug Dealer Simulator is nearly here! We know that despite the demo, many of you still want to see more of it. How about we give you one more chance to get into the world of the ghetto, but for a little bit longer?

We have thought about that, and here it is - [b]Drug Dealer Simulator: Free Sample![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/fe3c720c238cc5bff21b7f141cbb930ad280d3b1.jpg[/img]

But wait! There was a demo, and now another free version of the game is coming? We're in a hurry to explain that to you :)

Drug Dealer Simulator: Free Sample is not only a chance to stay in a crime world of drug dealing for a bit longer. It's also an opportunity to reach the new players that may get interested in the upcoming game.

Together with the content offered by the demo, [b]Drug Dealer Simulator: Free Sample has extended level limit to 8[/b]. That'll give you more time to get know with the rules of the streets before rising your own drug empire :)

And as you probably already noticed in title: [b]it'll be available for free for everyone![/b]

Drug Dealer Simulator: Free Sample will release faster than you may think, so we recommend to keep an eye on the Store and the upcoming news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/682990/Drug_Dealer_Simulator/

Do you have guts to try a free sample? ;)
